services.desc: Enjoy a light-hearted, nature inspired look at tiny critters. Explore insects like never before while looking at the artwork of Morgan Bulkeley, Adria Arch, and Jessica Strauss. Create an original work of art celebrating our small, insect friends. Drop into Art is designed to celebrate the creative potential in all of us. With new themes and projects every month, Drop into Art offers opportunities for kids with their caregivers and adults to explore and create together. The sessions are unique, fun, and free, emphasizing discovery, invention, improvisation, and hands-on creativity.
